name: Image Finding & Computer Vision (Image & Vision)
description: Provides screen template matching, multi-point color finding, pixel extraction, image cropping, and contour analysis

BlobAnalysis.description: Analyze isolated graphical blobs, computing area, bounding box, and count

CropImage.description: Crop a designated rectangular region from an image into a new sub-image

CvtColor.description: Convert image color format (e.g. RGB to Grayscale, BGR, HSV)

FindColor.description: Locate pixel coordinates matching specified color or color range

FindContours.description: Extract object boundary contours from binary images, calculating area and centroid

FindMultiColor.description: Accurately locate targets by matching multiple relative color anchor points

GetPixelColor.description: Retrieve the RGB color value of a specific coordinate to check button or status indicators

ImageBlur.description: Apply Gaussian or box blur to smooth out noise and artifacts

ImageComparison.description: Compare two images, calculate similarity percentage, and highlight changed regions

ImageInRange.description: Extract binary mask isolating pixels falling within specific lower/upper color thresholds

ImageMorphology.description: Perform dilation, erosion, opening, or closing to connect gaps or remove noise

ImageRotate.description: Rotate image by arbitrary angle or perform horizontal/vertical flips

ImageThreshold.description: Convert image to pure black/white binary image using Otsu or adaptive thresholding

MatchTemplate.description: Search for a sub-image template within screen or larger image by correlation matching

ResizeImage.description: Scale image dimensions by absolute width/height or proportional ratio

ShapeRecognition.description: Automatically detect geometric shapes (circles, rectangles, triangles, polygons)

TableGridDetect.description: Detect horizontal/vertical lines and grid structure in images to segment cells
